D.t: Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins leads by 9.5 in the forecast and wins 97% of simulations. The cushion is about 27,660 votes; a one point swing is about 1,454 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +3.4 and D +15.7. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
The polls page average is D +8.0. Your best recent poll is Alaska Survey Research at D +8.0; your worst is Data for Progress (D) at R +4.2. 7 polls in the last 30 days.

The biggest vote banks for Democrats: Anchorage Municipality, a projected net 43,011 votes; Juneau City and Borough, a projected net 9,012 votes; Fairbanks North Star Borough, a projected net 8,510 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.
The large counties within 12 points: Kenai Peninsula Borough, R +2.7, 9.4% of the vote; Copper River Census Area, R +5.0, 0.4% of the vote.

Groups big enough to move the race: White voters, 76% of voters, 45 to 28, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.81 points; Voters who cast ballots in 2022 and 2024, 69% of voters, 49 to 26, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.46 points; Midsize counties, 68% of voters, 48 to 26, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.42 points.

The forecast's worst groups for Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins: Immigration voters 23 to 43, Incomes $125K and up 43 to 30, White voters 45 to 28. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
$1.2M cash against $207K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
Air cover: Outside groups spent $1.6M helping Bernadette Wilson and $1.4M helping Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins.

R.t: Bernadette Wilson trails by 9.5 and wins 3% of simulations. Closing it takes about 13,830 voters switching sides, or 27,660 more net votes from new turnout.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +15.7 and D +3.4. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
The polls page average is D +8.0. Your best recent poll is Data for Progress (D) at R +4.2; your worst is Alaska Survey Research at D +8.0. 7 polls in the last 30 days.

The biggest vote banks for Republicans: Matanuska-Susitna Borough, a projected net 7,965 votes; Southeast Fairbanks Census Area, a projected net 934 votes; Kenai Peninsula Borough, a projected net 732 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.
The large counties within 12 points: Kenai Peninsula Borough, R +2.7, 9.4% of the vote; Copper River Census Area, R +5.0, 0.4% of the vote.

R.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
R.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Bernadette Wilson runs furthest behind in Sitka City and Borough, Juneau City and Borough, Bethel Census Area. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: White voters, 76% of voters, 28 to 45, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.81 points; Voters who cast ballots in 2022 and 2024, 69% of voters, 26 to 49, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.46 points; Midsize counties, 68% of voters, 26 to 48, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.42 points.

The forecast's worst groups for Bernadette Wilson: 2024 nonvoters and third party voters 14 to 67, Independents 18 to 68, Corruption voters 16 to 63. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
$207K cash against $1.2M. Outspent: lean on earned media, digital, field and the outside groups, and pick the two or three media markets that decide it.
